component.name: Messenger
component.summary: Native GTK4 and Libadwaita Facebook Messenger client

description.p: A fast, lightweight, native GTK4 and Libadwaita desktop client for Facebook Messenger with seamless GNOME 50 desktop integration, persistent session cookies, and background execution.
Fix reCAPTCHA and security verification dialog rendering by isolating custom styles and scripts strictly to the top frame.
Suppress notifications for self-sent outgoing messages and lock chat extraction strictly to the active top conversation.
Add rich native desktop notifications with sender avatar icons, clean message content extraction, click-to-activate window focus, background keep-alive, and consecutive message notifications.
Fix session logout issue by enabling persistent SQLite cookie storage and LocalStorage across restarts.
Initial release with native GTK4, Libadwaita, WebKit6, and GNOME Background Apps support.
